title: gsm_sim: Use common response handling
description:
Use dissect_rsp_apdu_tvb() to handle the response APDU for both
SIMtrace (combined command/response) and separate command/response.
This will simplify adding new response dissections.

Add some missing "Length of the subsequent data field" (Lc).
